feedback: This candidate has not yet been raced, so no telemetry data is available to evaluate its performance. The controller parameters have been adjusted to reduce base_speed to 1.35 to improve stability and reduce aggressive driving, increase kd to 4.0 to enhance damping and reduce oscillations, and set sensor_weights to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0] to increase the influence of inner sensors for better steering precision. The geometry remains unchanged, which is reasonable given no reported issues. Given the limited remaining runs and the lack of telemetry, I recommend approving this candidate to race and gather essential telemetry data on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation. This data will be critical to inform any final tuning decisions.
